scope: Internal single absolute XTEST motion packet, exact source/master RawMotion receipt ownership and precomputed pointer source-class copy with full native postchecks; no mouse business or click integration.

initial_results.finding: The XKB-drift test changed a fixture field not returned by its QueryPointer override. Changed the fixture to return an actual non-NoAction master button. Runtime bytes unchanged; no assertion weakened.

motion_packet.layout: Exactly one 36-byte XTEST FakeInput, absolute core MotionNotify6, CurrentTime, explicit proven root, signed16 request coordinates, no button or device/configuration write.
motion_packet.attribution: Exactly two same-reserved-sequence RawMotion17 receipts, source then paired master, source identity/detail0/flags0 and shared timestamp. Bounded1..8 mask words, exactly axes0/1, all other mask bits zero. Processed FP32.32 values then unprocessed values must equal the original plan; integral/fraction parsed separately.
motion_packet.partial_write: Before first byte reserve one request sequence and attach the actual monitor lease/events. Track exact sends through blocking/zero/error/cancel. An incomplete request is dropped with its stream; settlement never completes new motion. No automatic replay.
motion_packet.acknowledgment: Full request is followed only by the same-owner QueryPointer barrier. Valid protocol reply settles transport even when cursor/root/screen/mask/receipts make outcome unverified; motion has no held-button release suffix. emit additionally requires original root pixel, released logical mask, exact receipts, unchanged latch and complete post-copy guard.
motion_packet.uncertainty: Waiter cancellation cannot cancel the retained barrier task. Invalid/missing/timed-out acknowledgment keeps exact connection/lease/task, rejects other queries and does not start a replacement query or claim clean close. External window/session connection remains owned by its original owner.

pointer_copy.precompute: Fresh complete QueryDevice must match prepared PointerState and topology. Precompute master button-source/leading labels, all source axis/scroll classes and feedback head; retain actual master button count, tail labels/feedback, button maps and CTM. Duplicate feedback IDs or unsupported copy shape refuse before input.
pointer_copy.notification: At most one exact same-request XI SlaveSwitch before first RawMotion. Its payload describes SOURCE classes, not full master; canonical metadata compared exactly, only dynamic axis values and documented padding ignored. Missing notification is allowed only if actual before-state remains unchanged.
pointer_copy.postcheck: Actual topology/classes before/after full native focus/session/released/window/lineage, hit path, XTEST properties, complete button maps, XKB actions/environment, double actual feedback/CTM and RandR layout reads. Expected topology used only for read-only comparison until all proofs pass, then synchronously adopt precomputed topology/configuration. Never reset changed or rebind arbitrary current state.
pointer_copy.covered: Unequal source/master button counts and retained tails, unequal axis counts, scroll metadata on an unsupplied axis, nondefault feedback, unchanged master CTM, wrong/late/duplicate/missing class notifications, nondefault fractional raw/processed receipts, unnotified configuration/layout/focus drift and postcheck cancellation.

historical_limit_correction: Earlier pointer-actions evidence recorded the base Wire 66MB as an input effective cap. InputWire.read already enforces 1MiB before base Wire.read. Added explicit correction to historical evidence and current contract; no runtime limit changed.
native_configuration: All native connections/replies/stream writes injected. Actual complete WindowFocus preparation/postcheck and InputWire event readers exercised. Frozen HEAD plus own files, imported runtime path and before/after root/shadow SHA checked. Offline gate retained; Windows asyncio approved outside sandbox, no actual X11 server/input, user service stop or environment rebuild.
publication: Local-only commit. Specific remote transfer authorization still pending; no push retry.
